extension.summary: Browser dashboard for your Kodi add-ons and settings
extension.description: Kodi Manager is a dashboard you open in a browser on your phone or computer. It shows your skin, players and helper add-ons at a glance; lets you search and edit add-on settings with a backup before every change; keeps checkpoints you can restore and undo; reads Kodi's log; and opens Kodi's own Install from zip file dialog on the TV. Optional: cached rows keep a copy of slow add-on folders so home-screen widgets load instantly. It only listens on this device until you turn on Allow LAN access, and needs an access token.
extension.disclaimer: Changes are only made when you turn on Enable writes. Use it on a trusted home network only; the dashboard does not use HTTPS.
extension.news: 0.7.3: protected settings (spot and re-apply values an update reset), a nightly checkpoint of your add-on settings (last 7 kept) and Trakt/TorBox account checks with a warning before they fail. Full history: CHANGELOG.md on the project website.
